settings.sharedLibraryDesc: Your pieces (brand, price, tags, photo) become searchable by other members, anonymously — nobody can see they are yours. Turning it off removes them from future searches, but pieces others already imported stay in their own closet.

styleDescMan.Romantic: Soft tones and gentle fabrics: pastel colours, linen, softly cut shirts.

styleDesc.Minimal: Clean lines, few colors, no clutter — quality over decoration.
styleDesc.Editorial: Fashion-forward, styled like a magazine spread — bold silhouettes and combinations.
styleDesc.Quiet luxury: Understated, high-quality basics with no visible logos.
styleDesc.Parisian: Effortless, timeless French style — trench coats, striped tops, tailored basics.
styleDesc.Street: Casual, urban-inspired — sneakers, oversized fits, streetwear brands.
styleDesc.Romantic: Soft, feminine details — ruffles, florals, flowing fabrics.
styleDesc.Tailored: Structured, fitted pieces — blazers, precise cuts.
styleDesc.Bohemian: Free-spirited, textured, layered — prints, fringe, natural fabrics.
styleDesc.Vintage: Inspired by past decades — retro cuts, patterns and details.
styleDesc.Coastal: Relaxed, breezy, beach-inspired — linen, light colors, natural textures.

home.title: Home
home.body: Every day you'll find today's look here, chosen for the weather where you are, plus shortcuts to the rest of the app.

wardrobe.title: Closet
wardrobe.body: All your pieces. Tap + to add new ones: one photo, up to 50 photos or links at once, or a photo of a whole outfit.

stylist.title: Stylist
stylist.body: Build outfits on the canvas, ask your stylist for advice, and find your upcoming, worn and saved looks.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Plan what to wear day by day, log what you wore, and pack for your trips.

you.title: You
you.body: Profile, avatar for virtual try-on, colour analysis and insights. From here you reach Settings, where the full {{appName}} Guide lives.

start.title: Start here
start.body: Photograph the pieces you wear most: 3 pieces unlock your first look, 10 your outfits for the week. Several photos at once is the fastest way.
